evidence.text: Ardent Robotics Software makes motion-planning software for industrial robot arms. Trusted by a leading global automaker and two of the world's largest electronics manufacturers.
Our CEO is a former robotics researcher and speaks regularly at industry conferences. We partner with major robot manufacturers to certify our software.
Ardent Path runs on an industrial PC next to the robot controller, so trajectories are computed locally without a network connection.
